purpose: Reconstructed local inference using public pretrained multi-label models; not the missing original CivicBalance checkpoint.

models.source_data: Model card identifies Jigsaw Toxic Comment Classification Challenge training data.
models.limitations: This Hugging Face variant differs from Detoxify releases. Published Detoxify results are not evaluation results for this reconstruction. Toxicity scores can reflect dataset bias and do not establish intent.

models.source_data: GoEmotions, English Reddit comments labeled with 27 emotions plus neutral.
models.limitations: The application selects the original project's six positive emotion categories from this 28-label model. Lack of these signals does not establish negative sentiment or neutrality.

score_interpretation: Sigmoid model scores are uncalibrated. The weighted net_goodness score is a heuristic, not confidence, accuracy, or an objective measure of a person.
